items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: And he had a coauthor, a lady named Marilyn, you know -- Mary Boyington.

ctx.x: Yeah, you see. So, Robert Dahdah, he was known as Bob. And -- but everyone liked to called him Dardo because he was like, you know. And he had a coauthor, a lady named Marilyn, you know -- Mary Boyington. And they wrote this play called 'Curly McDimple,' and it was doing into its third year, you see, in the Burt Wheeler Theater there, (unintelligible) and Woolsey you know. (Laughter)

So, I had to laugh, see, because they had a Bill Bojangles Robinson character was featured in that, similar about -- he and Shirley McDimple. Shirley McDimple is like a little -- what do you call them when they leave the baby in the baskets, you know?
